methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series C → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.7x) to $165M total raised proxy.

private.name: Meter
private.rationale: Same sector (Housing & Construction), same stage (Series C)

data.narrative:
ICON operates in the Housing & Construction sector at Series C, having raised $450M+ to date. The comp universe is sparse: no public comparables and a single identified private peer (Meter), reflecting the nascent state of the frontier-construction technology market and limited trading visibility.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable here. Using total capital raised ($450M+) as a proxy baseline yields $165M, to which a typical Series C-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.7x is applied, implying a valuation of $280.5M. This method captures the capital intensity and development trajectory characteristic of hardware-enabled construction ventures, though it relies on a single empirical input given comp scarcity.

The triangulation analysis supports a range of $238M (low) to $323M (high), with a median of $280M. The narrow confidence band reflects reliance on a single valuation method rather than multiple independent triangulations. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 1.7x multiplier for ICON's specific market dynamics, the limited comparability of available peers, and undisclosed revenue or unit economics that would materially refine stage-appropriate multiples. Investors should require additional data on production volumes, gross margins, and customer concentration before anchoring to the upper quartile of this range.
